title: Explicit route text was not enough to actually find the destination. Status said 'the Keepers' pilgrim stair at Coldpass opens for you now. North through Wardmoor, past Highward,' and from the ruined signal tower's top the text literally says 'Coldpass is a white line north.' Despite that, walking the full moor (Last Cairn, Oath-Ground, Long Sight, Windbreak Stones, Tower Rise/signal tower, Waystation Track, Drover's Rest, West Shieling, Twin Ruts, Peat Score, Boot-Track Hollow — a closed loop) never produced an exit toward Coldpass or Marrowgate. This is what ultimately cost the run its ending.
